item.title: Personal Finance (3): Bank Wealth Management Subsidiaries — What '理财子' Actually Means
item.description:
Colleagues kept saying “I moved everything to ICBC’s 理财子,” and I kept nodding like I understood. I didn’t. So I spent a Saturday on prospectuses and regulatory PDFs. Here’s what a wealth management subsidiary is, why it exists, and how to read one of its products without getting fooled.

What Is a Wealth Management Subsidiary?#

A 理财子公司 is a separately licensed company a bank spins up to manage investment products. It has its own legal identity, its own capital, its own regulatory obligations. ICBC has 工银理财, CMB has 招银理财, ABC has 农银理财 — every major bank now has one.
